scope.summary: Implement the CPU/convolution blur StudioLiveFilter kinds sharing the studio-engine blur-core: Average (fill-with-mean), Basic Blur / Blur More, Box Blur (radius), Gaussian Blur (R,V,T,G canonical uniform blur), Median Blur (edge-preserving speckle removal), Bilateral Blur (edge-aware range threshold), Motion Blur (angle -360..+360, intensity 1-999), Radial Blur spin/zoom (draft/good/best), Shape Blur (custom-shape kernel), Smart/Selective Blur (radius/threshold/quality/normal-edge-overlay modes), Surface Blur (radius+threshold), Diffuse Glow (white-noise bloom from highlights). All re-editable stack entries; Opt rows have CPU path.
acceptance_criteria: Average, Basic/Blur More, Box, Gaussian, Median, Bilateral, Motion, Radial, Shape, Smart/Selective, Surface, Diffuse Glow implemented + re-editable
expected_tests: test: Gaussian/Box/Median/Bilateral radius correctness; Motion angle+intensity; Radial spin/zoom; Smart-blur edge modes; Diffuse Glow bloom

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Core blur set missing; uniform layer blur + speckle/edge blur unavailable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
